dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline with distinct irregular notches localized at the basal posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Moderately rounded apex with an obtuse morphological shape and significant pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear anterior margin approximately 65 degrees relative to the visible horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-to-base ratio of approximately 1.15:1 based on visible points of emergence from the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent V-shaped notches on the lower trailing edge of the dorsal fin. Extensive distribution of small, circular white scars and depigmented speckling across the entire visible flank and fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast micro-speckling pattern across the dark pigmentation of the dorsal and lateral regions.
